subject.title: feat: add Google Cloud Run sandbox provider

question: Should Crabbox officially support Google Cloud Run Sandboxes in public preview as a built-in provider with a shared-secret remote gateway and direct in-container CLI mode?
rationale: The code is a substantial new provider and the contributor demonstrated the proposed behavior, but whether Crabbox should permanently own this preview-service integration and gateway security contract is a repository product and support decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Sponsor the provider
options.body: Approve the built-in provider direction, then require removal of the release-owned changelog edit and complete ordinary merge review of the gateway contract.

options.title: Defer built-in support
options.body: Keep the capability out of the built-in provider registry until Cloud Run Sandboxes and the gateway contract are stable enough to support.

options.title: Redirect to an external integration
options.body: Ask for a separately distributed integration if maintainers do not want to carry preview-provider lifecycle and security support in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the provider
recommendation.body: Approve the built-in provider direction, then require removal of the release-owned changelog edit and complete ordinary merge review of the gateway contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed person currently connected to the proposed provider and its live validation; repository ownership history for the adjacent current-main provider code was not available in the supplied inspection context.
